narrationTexts: Confirms the bug in `orderTotal` — tax is computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted total.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green: `625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing`.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Only rows with both a discount and tax exposed it, which most rows hid.

Nothing else pending.
